# United States Department of Justice

> Official website of the U.S. Department of Justice, providing information on DOJ leadership, agencies, news, legal resources, public services, and policy guidance.

The Department of Justice enforces federal law, defends the interests of the United States, promotes public safety, and works to ensure fair and impartial administration of justice. This site includes department-wide information, component agencies, public guidance, forms, grants, FOIA resources, and extensive news and publications.

## About DOJ
- [About the Department of Justice](https://www.justice.gov/about): Overview of DOJ mission, structure, leadership, and responsibilities.
- [The Attorney General](https://www.justice.gov/ag): Information about the Attorney General and related leadership activities.
- [Organizational Chart](https://www.justice.gov/agencies/chart/map): Interactive map of DOJ components and organizational structure.
- [Our Offices](https://www.justice.gov/agencies/chart/grid): Directory of DOJ offices, divisions, and component agencies.
- [Budget & Performance](https://www.justice.gov/doj/budget-and-performance): Budget documents, performance reports, and strategic planning materials.
- [History](https://www.justice.gov/history): Historical information, milestones, and records of the Department.
- [Privacy Program](https://www.justice.gov/opcl): DOJ privacy policy, compliance, and civil liberties resources.

## Our Work and Public Services
- [Our Work](https://www.justice.gov/our-work): Overview of DOJ priorities, initiatives, and major areas of work.
- [Find Help and Information for Crime Victims](https://www.justice.gov/action-center/find-help-and-information-crime-victims): Support resources and information for crime victims and families.
- [Action Center](https://www.justice.gov/action-center): Public assistance hub for reporting, complaints, and help topics.
- [Report a Crime or Submit a Complaint](https://www.justice.gov/action-center/report-crime-or-submit-complaint): Guidance for reporting crimes and filing complaints with DOJ.
- [Contact Us](https://www.justice.gov/contact-us): Department contact information and office-specific contact options.
- [Resources](https://www.justice.gov/resources): Central index of DOJ public resources and reference materials.

## News and Media
- [News](https://www.justice.gov/news): DOJ news hub for announcements, statements, and media content.
- [Press Releases](https://www.justice.gov/news/press-releases): Official DOJ press releases on enforcement actions and department announcements.
- [Speeches](https://www.justice.gov/news/speeches): Remarks and speeches from DOJ leaders and officials.
- [Videos](https://www.justice.gov/news/videos): Video content featuring DOJ announcements, events, and public messages.
- [Photo Galleries](https://www.justice.gov/news/photo-galleries): Official photo collections from DOJ events and activities.
- [Blogs](https://www.justice.gov/news/blogs): DOJ blog posts covering initiatives, policy, and public information.
- [Podcasts](https://www.justice.gov/news/podcasts): Audio programs and podcast content from DOJ offices and initiatives.

## Guidance, Forms, and Policies
- [Guidance Documents](https://www.justice.gov/guidance): Department guidance documents and policy-related materials.
- [Forms](https://www.justice.gov/forms): Public forms for DOJ programs, requests, and submissions.
- [FOIA.gov](https://www.foia.gov/): Government-wide Freedom of Information Act portal managed by DOJ.
- [Office of Information Policy](https://www.justice.gov/oip): DOJ FOIA policy, guidance, training, and compliance resources.
- [Justice Manual](https://www.justice.gov/jm/justice-manual): Official manual for DOJ legal policies and procedures.
- [Regulations.gov DOJ Search](https://www.regulations.gov/): Federal rulemaking portal for DOJ-related regulations and notices.

## Grants and Funding
- [Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/): DOJ office supporting criminal and juvenile justice programs, research, and grants.
- [Bureau of Justice Assistance](https://bja.ojp.gov/): Funding, training, and technical assistance for justice system improvements.
- [Office for Victims of Crime](https://ovc.ojp.gov/): Victim assistance resources, funding opportunities, and training materials.
- [Office on Violence Against Women](https://www.justice.gov/ovw): Grants, policy guidance, and resources addressing domestic and sexual violence.
- [Community Oriented Policing Services](https://cops.usdoj.gov/): Grants and resources supporting community policing nationwide.
- [National Institute of Justice](https://nij.ojp.gov/): Research, evaluation, and evidence-based justice publications and funding information.

## Civil Rights and Public Protection
- [Civil Rights Division](https://www.justice.gov/crt): Enforcement information on civil rights laws and related complaints.
- [Civil Division](https://www.justice.gov/civil): Information on federal civil litigation, fraud enforcement, and legal defense.
- [Criminal Division](https://www.justice.gov/criminal): Criminal enforcement priorities, policy guidance, and division resources.
- [Environment and Natural Resources Division](https://www.justice.gov/enrd): Litigation and enforcement involving environmental and natural resources laws.
- [National Security Division](https://www.justice.gov/nsd): National security law, counterterrorism, and counterintelligence information.
- [Antitrust Division](https://www.justice.gov/atr): Competition law enforcement, merger review, and antitrust policy resources.
- [Office on Violence Against Women](https://www.justice.gov/ovw): Programs and legal resources addressing violence against women.

## Law Enforcement and Corrections Components
- [Federal Bureau of Investigation](https://www.fbi.gov/): Federal investigative agency information, services, and public resources.
- [Drug Enforcement Administration](https://www.dea.gov/): Drug enforcement information, diversion control, and public safety resources.
- [Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives](https://www.atf.gov/): Firearms, explosives, arson, and trafficking enforcement information.
- [United States Marshals Service](https://www.usmarshals.gov/): Fugitive operations, witness security, and federal judicial security resources.
- [Bureau of Prisons](https://www.bop.gov/): Federal prison system information, inmate resources, and policies.
- [Office of the Pardon Attorney](https://www.justice.gov/pardon): Clemency application guidance and pardon process information.

## Immigration and Executive Review
- [Executive Office for Immigration Review](https://www.justice.gov/eoir): Immigration courts, Board of Immigration Appeals, and related resources.
- [EOIR Courts & Appeals System](https://acis.eoir.justice.gov/): Online case information and filing tools for immigration proceedings.
- [Office of Immigration Litigation](https://www.justice.gov/civil/office-immigration-litigation): Civil Division office handling immigration-related federal litigation.
- [Immigrant and Employee Rights Section](https://www.justice.gov/crt/immigrant-and-employee-rights-section): Civil rights enforcement involving immigration-related employment discrimination.

## Data, Research, and Publications
- [Bureau of Justice Statistics](https://bjs.ojp.gov/): Federal justice data, statistical reports, and analytical publications.
- [National Criminal Justice Reference Service](https://www.ojp.gov/ncjrs): Justice and victim services publications, abstracts, and resources.
- [Office of Legal Policy](https://www.justice.gov/olp): Policy development materials and legal policy information.
- [Office of Public Affairs](https://www.justice.gov/opa): Media relations, public communications, and department announcements.
- [Publications](https://www.justice.gov/jmd/page/file/1033651/dl): DOJ publications and reference materials collection.
- [Archive](https://www.justice.gov/archive): Archived DOJ website content and historical materials.

## Transparency and Oversight
- [Office of the Inspector General](https://oig.justice.gov/): Independent oversight, audits, investigations, and reports on DOJ programs.
- [Office of Professional Responsibility](https://www.justice.gov/opr): Oversight of attorney conduct and professional responsibility matters.
- [Office of Information Policy](https://www.justice.gov/oip): FOIA administration, policy guidance, and annual reporting resources.
- [Open Government at DOJ](https://www.justice.gov/open): Open government plans, transparency initiatives, and accountability information.
- [Privacy and Civil Liberties Office](https://www.justice.gov/opcl): Privacy impact assessments, civil liberties, and compliance resources.
- [No FEAR Act Data](https://www.justice.gov/jmd/no-fear-act-data): Required reporting on equal employment opportunity complaint data.
